Manage templates

Aliases:

* template

## Usage

```console
coder templates
```

## Description

```console
Templates are written in standard Terraform and describe the infrastructure for workspaces
  - Create or push an update to the template. Your developers can update their
workspaces:

     $ coder templates push my-template
```
